name: vercel
label: Vercel
description: Deploy projects and manage environment variables on Vercel.

token.label: Vercel Access Token
token.description: Create a token in Vercel Settings → Tokens.

teamId.label: Team ID
teamId.description: Optional. Use this to target a specific Vercel team.

slug.label: Team Slug
slug.description: Optional. Team slug. Ignored when Team ID is provided.

get_deployment_status.label: Get Deployment Status
get_deployment_status.description: Retrieve a deployment and inspect its current status.

list_environment_variables.label: List Environment Variables
list_environment_variables.description: Retrieve environment variables for a Vercel project.

decrypt.label: Decrypt Values
decrypt.description: Deprecated by Vercel. If enabled, Vercel will attempt to return decrypted values when allowed.

git_branch.label: Git Branch
git_branch.description: Optional branch filter. Only valid for preview-scoped variables.
